osaka_ramen_goku_honten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; fried rice with sauces on the table.
osaka_ramen_goku_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth; back fat; chashu; egg on the char-rice.
osaka_ramen_goku_honten.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00; closing days not fixed; hours may change (Tabelog). Buy tickets at the machine outside (September 2026). Cash or PayPay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog).
osaka_ramen_goku_honten.notes: [Ramen · light tonkotsu and egg-topped char-rice by Tennoji] A nine-seat, dimly lit counter about five minutes from Tennoji, known for its char-rice: fried rice under a fluffy omelet, seasoned lightly on purpose so you finish it with the garlic or wasabi sauces on the table. The tonkotsu comes white, black (with black garlic oil) or red, and one diner found it lighter and less salty than expected, closer to Mokkosu than Hakata; it comes with about five slices of chashu and wood ear mushroom. Extra back fat is free, and so are pickled ginger, spicy takana, grated garlic, fried onion and mayonnaise. The Manpuku set pairs a bowl with a small char-rice. A chashu chuka soba (¥1,300) on thick noodles is the other option. Free half-size kaedama until 15:00 on weekdays. Buy tickets at the machine outside; cash or PayPay only.

chef_bio.background: Tonkotsu ramen shop, main store (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A shop that seriously makes pork bone soup" (shop phrase quoted in an October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkotsu ramen in three styles; char-rice.

anecdotes.text: "The ramen is tonkotsu and you can choose from white, black, or red. I opted for the black with black garlic oil… The char rice, which is fried rice topped with an omelet, was incredibly tasty. The omelet was fluffy…" — September 2026, Manpuku set.
"The flavor was lighter and less salty than I expected, resembling more of a Mokkosu style than Hakata. I ordered extra fat, but it wasn't overwhelming…" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らーめん 極 本店、大阪市阿倍野区旭町1-1-26 ウエムラあべのビル 1F、天王寺駅から約5分、動物園前駅から約5分、毎日11:00〜22:00、定休日不定、カード・電子マネー不可、QRはPayPay可、カウンター9席。口コミ(2026年9〜10月): Char-rice で知られる豚骨ラーメンの本店、外の券売機、Manpuku Set (ラーメンと小さな Char-rice)、豚骨は Shiro、Kuro (黒にんにく油)、Aka の3種、背脂増し無料、きくらげ、チャーシュー約5枚、博多より Mokkosu に近いあっさりで塩気控えめ、平日15時まで半替え玉無料、卓上に黒胡椒、山椒、ごま、唐辛子とご飯用の3種のソース、無料トッピングに紅しょうが、辛子高菜、おろしにんにく、フライドオニオン、マヨネーズ、Char-rice はふわふわのオムレツをのせた薄味の炒めご飯、店員が親切、チャーシュー中華そば1,300円は太麺と味付きメンマ。

osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; soy-sauce soup; chili oil.
osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat broth; beef horumon; chashu; egg yolk and quail eggs.
osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:15 and 17:30–21:15; closed the evening of the third Tuesday each month; occasional temporary closures, check Google Maps (Tabelog). Check in on the touch panel out front, then buy a ticket inside (2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.notes: [Ramen · punchy chili-and-garlic chuka soba by Tenmabashi] An eleven-seat shop a minute from Tenmabashi, open since 2023 and now busy thanks to social media: check in on the touch panel out front and expect a wait (about 25 minutes to get in, one August lunch). The chuka soba is shoyu loaded with chili and fresh garlic; one diner calls this kind of punch rare in Kansai, where Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto has no shops, while another found it a fairly standard shoyu with chili. The beef horumon chuka soba brings more chili and garlic, and one diner found the sour and spicy djanmen (¥1,800) rich to the last bite. Limited bowls rotate: Bachiro (¥1,100 with extra sprouts) on borrowed noodles, and a chilled tantan mazesoba in summer. Add a meat-taku rice bowl (¥550). Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.specialty: Spicy chuka soba with chili and garlic; limited bowls.

anecdotes.text: "The Chuka Soba here is known for its spiciness, featuring chili peppers as a highlight. I ordered the spicy Chuka Soba with beef offal in a large size." — August 2026; about 25 minutes in line to get inside.
"I added some garlic from the table and got ready to dig in. This chuka soba seemed like it was made just for someone like me, who loves garlic and chili." — October 2026, beef horumon chuka soba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華そば 辻、大阪市中央区釣鐘町1-1-1、天満橋駅④出口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜14:15・17:30〜21:15、毎月第3火曜の夜は休み、臨時休業あり、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay を含む) 可、11席(カウンター7、2人掛けテーブル2)、2023年4月11日開店。口コミ(2026年5〜10月): 店前のタッチパネルで受付、店内で食券、SNSで人気になり行列、約25分で入店、唐辛子が主役の辛い中華そば、牛ホルモンの中華そば大盛り、関西では珍しいパンチ、Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto との比較、限定のバチ郎 (もやし増し1,100円、別ブランドの麺、濃口醤油、たっぷりのチャーシュー)、バチ郎 うずら増し、バチ郎 ホルモン増し、龍のたまごのTKG、肉タク丼550円、バッチバチ牛ホル中華そば、夏の冷やし担々まぜそば (特製はうずら卵とキムチ)、特製酸辣ジャンメン1,800円、唐辛子と生にんにくの醤油ラーメンで普通だったという声、卵黄、卓上のにんにく、ストレートの細麺を出す Mokkosu を思い出したという声、豚の火入れや脂にばらつきがあったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Digital check-in out front, and staff came out to explain it (October 2026); ticket inside.

osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; soy tare; doubanjiang on the table.
osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone and chicken broth; chicken oil; pork chashu; egg.
osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); hours may change (Tabelog). Free rice (100 or 150 g) at lunch; no refills (2026). Buy tickets at the machine; state noodle firmness, flavor strength and oil when handing it over. Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.notes: [Ramen · lighter iekei with smoked chashu by Tsuruhashi] An eight-seat counter about ten minutes from Tsuruhashi, open since May 2025, with lines on weekends. The broth of pork bones and chicken carcasses is creamy and rich but easy to drink, with a mild soy tare and chicken oil, over chewy medium-thick short noodles from Inoue Seimen; order firmness, flavor and oil to taste. Smoked, oven-roasted thigh chashu (firm and meaty) and shredded chashu sit with komatsuna and nori. The jō ramen (¥1,000) adds chashu, nori and half an egg. Rice is free at lunch; top it with the pickled cucumber and furikake, and finish with doubanjiang from the table. One diner calls it possibly the best iekei in Osaka; another found the broth thinner and the chashu dry on a later visit. Staff see you off at the door.

chef_bio.specialty: Iekei ramen with smoked thigh chashu.

anecdotes.text: "The broth, made from simmered pork bones and chicken carcasses, has a rich umami flavor. It strikes a nice balance with a mild soy sauce taste, making it easy to drink… The noodles are medium-thick, short noodles from Inoue Seimen…" — September 2026, jō ramen ¥1,000.

"The noodles were thick and had a strong texture, giving a firm impression with less chewiness. The chashu was moist and tender, with a perfect contrast of smoky flavor and meaty goodness." — October 2026, firm noodles and extra oil.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 家系ラーメン 船場家、大阪市天王寺区味原町4-8、鶴橋から398m、毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、カウンター8席、2025年5月31日開店。口コミ(2026年8〜10月): 豚骨と鶏ガラのスープ、マイルドな醤油、Inoue Seimen の中太の短い麺、燻製したオーブン焼きの豚もものチャーシューと刻みチャーシュー、小松菜、ねぎ、海苔、10月24・25日だけ豚バラのチャーシュー、チャーシューラーメン1,100円、Jō Ramen 1,000円 (チャーシュー1枚、海苔2枚、味玉半分を追加)、昼はライス100gか150gが無料、おかわりなし、ほうれん草に変更50円、刻み玉ねぎ100円、ライス200g 100円、卓上に豆板醤、にんにく、生姜、酢、ごま、ラーメンペッパー、きゅうりの漬物、ふりかけ、麺の硬さ・味の濃さ・油の量を選べる、明るく丁寧な接客、見送り、週末は行列、クリーミーで濃厚なスープ、Rokukaku-ya に似ているという声、大阪の家系で一番かもという声、2回目はスープが薄くチャーシューが乾いていたという声、券売機。

osaka_maren_higobashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles; soy-based sauce.
osaka_maren_higobashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken sauces and paitan; chashu; seasoned egg; niboshi vinegar.
osaka_maren_higobashi.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–22:00 (Tabelog). Order on the touch panel; long lines after 12:00 at lunch (2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_maren_higobashi.notes: [Ramen · tidy mazesoba with a rice finish at Higobashi] An eleven-seat shop right by Higobashi exit 9, open since April 2023 and part of MAREN, the mazesoba shop with a branch in Shinsaibashi. The shoyu mazesoba (¥980) coats thick, chewy noodles in a sauce that's rich but not heavy and arrives neatly arranged; add niboshi vinegar halfway, then mix the small scoop of rice into what's left. The chicken shio mazesoba gets its lift from shiso, and there's a chicken shoyu chashu version. The chicken paitan ramen is less loved: one diner saw it made from powders blended into a clear liquid on an IH burner. Order on the touch panel. Lines build after 12:00, so go early or late. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.background: Mazesoba shop; sister shop of MAREN Shinsaibashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "The thick noodles are coated in a flavorful sauce that's delicious! It's rich but not too heavy… I added some niboshi vinegar for a flavor change, which made it even smoother!" — October 2026, shoyu mazesoba.
"To finish off, you can mix in a small plate of rice, which is so tasty that I can't help but finish it all…" — September 2026, shoyu mazesoba ¥980.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: MAREN 肥後橋、大阪市西区江戸堀1-15-7、四つ橋線肥後橋駅9番出口から69m、毎日10:30〜22:00、カード・電子マネー・QR可、11席、2023年4月1日開店。口コミ(2026年8〜10月): 醤油まぜそば980円、太麺に濃厚だが重すぎないたれ、途中で煮干し酢、最後に小さなご飯を混ぜる、鶏塩まぜそば (ミニご飯付き) は大葉の風味ともちもちの麺、味玉150円、タッチパネルで注文、鶏醤油チャーシューまぜそばは見た目がおしゃれでマイルド、たれがたっぷり、12時を過ぎると行列、昼は時間をずらすのがおすすめ、グッズ、鶏白湯はIHの小鍋で透明な液体に粉を混ぜて作っていたという声、近くの Zagin が行列でこちらへという声。

osaka_ramen_three_hanare_higobashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; shoyu and shio tare; chashu mayo rice.
osaka_ramen_three_hanare_higobashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: clam, scallop and dried-seafood broth; pork bone; chicken and pork chashu; egg.
osaka_ramen_three_hanare_higobashi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 7:00–11:00 (morning ramen), 11:15–15:00 and 17:30–23:00; Sat and public holidays 11:15–15:00; closed Sun (Tabelog). Register on LINE and the fourth bowl is free after three (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master), IC cards, iD and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_ramen_three_hanare_higobashi.notes: [Ramen · clam-broth ramen and a ¥650 breakfast bowl at Higobashi] A stylish ten-seat counter three minutes from Higobashi, open since October 2025 and sharing its name with Ramen ThreE nearby. The house bowl is a light broth of clam, scallop and dried seafood, with clam out front, over straight, medium-thin low-hydration noodles, topped with two kinds of chicken chashu and rare pork loin; sansho from the table lifts the aroma. There's also a clam and Kyoto bonito chuka soba, a creamy clam-and-pork shio and a rich tonkotsu shoyu. On weekdays it opens at 7:00 for morning ramen (¥650) with free egg-over-rice or natto rice. One diner found the morning bowls a bit salty. Register on LINE and the fourth bowl is free. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.background: Ramen counter; Tabelog corporate member (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Clam and shellfish ramen; weekday morning ramen.

anecdotes.text: "The soup was a blend of clam, scallop, and dried seafood, with the clam flavor being slightly dominant. It was a light broth… The noodles were straight, medium-thin, and had a low water content, giving them a nice bite." — October 2026, clam tare ramen (shoyu).
"With the morning ramen, you can enjoy free egg over rice or natto rice. Both the Shoyu Ramen and the clam broth ramen are priced the same at JPY 650." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメンすりぃ はなれ、大阪市西区江戸堀1-16-31、肥後橋駅から徒歩3分、月〜金 7:00〜11:00・11:15〜15:00・17:30〜23:00、土・祝 11:15〜15:00、日休み、カード(VISA、Master)・交通系IC・iD・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay を含む) 可、カウンター10席、2025年10月15日開店。口コミ(2026年10月): 貝、ホタテ、乾物の魚介のあっさりスープ、ストレートの中細の低加水麺、低温調理の鶏と皮付きの焼き鶏と豚ロースのレアチャーシュー、卓上の陳皮、七味、山椒、特製Bトッピング、焼豚丼はごま油、朝ラーメン650円 (醤油、貝、鶏醤油) に卵かけご飯か納豆ご飯が無料、LINE登録で3杯食べると1杯無料、貝と京都の鰹節の中華そば、濃厚豚骨醤油ラーメン、貝のスープのクリーミーな豚塩ラーメンと小さなチャーシューマヨご飯、おしゃれな店内、親切な店員、行列、朝の一杯が少し塩辛いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter; friendly staff (October 2026); cards and QR accepted.

osaka_okamoto_shoten_hanare_tenmabashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; soy tare; kara-age; curry rice.
osaka_okamoto_shoten_hanare_tenmabashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken paitan and seafood broths; chashu; egg.
osaka_okamoto_shoten_hanare_tenmabashi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00; Sat and public holidays 11:00–18:00; Sun 11:00–16:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Ramen at lunch; all-you-can-eat-and-drink izakaya in the evening (Tabelog). Free mini rice bowl from 13:30 (September 2026). Cash or PayPay; no cards or e-money; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Formerly 麺屋きょうすけ (Tabelog).
osaka_okamoto_shoten_hanare_tenmabashi.notes: [Ramen · chicken stewed ramen and lunch sets, izakaya by night, by Tenmabashi] A fifteen-seat basement counter on Tanimachi-suji, five minutes from Tenmabashi, serving ramen at lunch and turning into an all-you-can-eat-and-drink izakaya in the evening; by name and one diner's account, it is a branch of Okamoto Shoten near Kitahama. The chicken stewed ramen (¥950, with chashu and egg) looks rich and frothy but drinks smooth, with chicken sweetness. The menu is long: sets pair a bowl with a mini rice bowl, chicken curry or kara-age, and there's seafood shoyu with rare chashu, chicken paitan tsukemen and a spicy seafood ramen that one diner found heavy and short on seafood. Another found the ramen average but good value. From 13:30 a mini rice bowl is free. Cash or PayPay; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 19 August 2013 (Tabelog), formerly 麺屋きょうすけ; a branch of Okamoto Shoten near Kitahama (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Ramen shop by day, izakaya by night (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The chicken simmered ramen looked quite rich with its frothy appearance, but surprisingly, it wasn't too heavy. The broth was smooth, with a delightful balance of chicken umami and sweetness." — September 2026, set F ¥1,000.
"The seafood shoyu ramen arrived with grilled chashu and a huge piece of rare chashu on top—so tender and incredibly delicious!" — October 2026, set D with chicken curry rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 岡本商店 はなれ (旧店名 麺屋きょうすけ)、大阪市中央区谷町2-1-22 フェアステージ大手前ビル B1F、天満橋駅から徒歩5分、谷町四丁目駅から徒歩7分、月〜金 11:00〜23:00、土・祝 11:00〜18:00、日 11:00〜16:00、定休日不定、昼はラーメン、夜は食べ飲み放題の居酒屋、カード・電子マネー不可、QRはPayPay可、カウンター15席、喫煙可、2013年8月19日開店。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 北浜近くの店の支店、13時半からミニ丼無料、チャーシューたっぷり、ラーメンは普通という声、谷町筋の地下、辛さを選べる辛い魚介ラーメン950円は濃くて魚介の味がしなかったという声、鶏白湯の醤油つけ麺 (中太ストレート、鶏油)、セットF 1,000円 (鶏の煮込みラーメンとミニ丼か揚げ物)、焼きチャーシューマヨ丼、もやし、Instagramフォローで100円トッピング無料、鶏の煮込みラーメン950円はチャーシューと卵付き、元気で親切な店員、セットDは魚介醤油ラーメンとチキンカレーライス、唐揚げ、メニューが多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Energetic, friendly staff (September 2026); cash or PayPay.

osaka_menya_shin_yodoyabashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thin wheat noodles; tare; chashu sauce.
osaka_menya_shin_yodoyabashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and chicken paitan double soup; pork chashu; egg.
osaka_menya_shin_yodoyabashi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sun and public holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Pay when ordering (2026). Rice ¥200, ¥100 at lunch (October 2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_menya_shin_yodoyabashi.notes: [Ramen · seafood-and-chicken paitan in the Yodoyabashi basement] An eight-seat, calm, Japanese-style counter in the basement of the Keihan Yodoyabashi Building, reachable underground from Yodoyabashi and Kitahama, open since 2023 as a new concept from Yawaragi, an izakaya in Shinsaibashi. The ramen (¥850) is a double soup of seafood and chicken paitan, slightly thick, rich but easy to drink, with the seafood coming through as you slurp the thin, firm, low-hydration Menya Teigaku noodles. Tender pork-belly chashu comes in thick slices in the chashu ramen (¥1,000). Finish with Dive Rice: kimchi rice you drop into the last of the soup. Rice is half price at lunch. Pay as you order. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 10 May 2023 (Tabelog); a new concept from the Shinsaibashi izakaya Yawaragi (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Ramen counter in the Keihan Yodoyabashi Building basement (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood and chicken paitan double-soup ramen.

anecdotes.text: "Taking a sip of the broth, I immediately noticed the pleasant seafood flavor, supported by the rich taste of chicken paitan… The thin noodles were cooked to a perfect firmness, offering a nice bite." — October 2026, chashu ramen ¥1,000.
"After finishing the ramen, you dive the rice into the broth, and it's absolutely delightful! It even comes topped with kimchi…" — October 2026, Dive Rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺や 信、大阪市中央区北浜3-2-25 京阪淀屋橋ビル B1F、淀屋橋駅・北浜駅、月〜金 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、土 11:00〜15:00、日・祝休み、カード・電子マネー・QR可、カウンター8席、2023年5月10日開店。口コミ(2026年9〜10月): 魚介と鶏白湯のダブルスープでややとろみ、濃厚だが飲みやすい、京都の Menya Teigaku の細い低加水麺、ちょうどいい硬さ、豚バラのチャーシュー、メンマ、ねぎ、玉ねぎ、ラーメン850円、チャーシューラーメン1,000円 (厚いチャーシュー3枚、味玉で1,150円)、キムチのせのご飯をスープに入れる Dive Rice、チャーシュー丼300円、ご飯200円が昼は100円、先払い、落ち着いた和の雰囲気、雨でも淀屋橋駅・北浜駅から濡れずに行ける、心斎橋の居酒屋 Yawaragi の新業態、器の縁が立体的。

cultural_comfort.note: Calm counter; pay as you order (2026).

osaka_mendokoro_hack_kujo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; soy-sauce fried rice; gyoza.
osaka_mendokoro_hack_kujo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shellfish broth and white tonkotsu soup; chashu; salmon; egg.
osaka_mendokoro_hack_kujo.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun, public holidays 11:00–22:30, continuous (announced on the shop Instagram); closed Thu; hours may change (Tabelog, not owner-verified). Ticket machine at the entrance (2026). Cash only (September 2026 review; Tabelog).
osaka_mendokoro_hack_kujo.notes: [Ramen · kombu-shellfish chuka soba and seasonal white soups, with wok fried rice, by Kujo] A clean counter by Kujo Station, open here since April 2025 after moving from Namba, where you can watch the fried rice tossed in the wok and the bowls carefully plated. The most popular bowl is the chuka soba: a kombu and shellfish broth with a strong wheat aroma from the noodles and two kinds of chashu, one a grilled pork belly. The white tonkotsu soba changes every three months; autumn 2026 is salmon and miso in a frothy soup with sautéed vegetables (¥1,180). Summer brings a chilled tantanmen with cream cheese and lemon. The fried rice, fluffy with burnt soy and optional butter, draws its own fans (one diner warns it can taste a bit salty), and the set (¥1,580) pairs it with a bowl. Warm service. Buy a ticket at the entrance; cash only. Closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.origin: Opened in Namba on 12 December 2022 and moved to Kujo on 1 April 2025; a second shop, mendokoro HACK Nakazaki, opened March 2026 (October 2026 review; Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Chuka soba; seasonal white tonkotsu soba; wok fried rice.

anecdotes.text: "Ordering the Chuka Soba was definitely the right decision! The aroma is irresistible. It's made with kombu kelp and shellfish broth! And the wheat aroma is just amazing." — September 2026.

"The miso white tonkotsu broth is covered with fine bubbles… The noodles are loosely wavy. They have a smooth texture that glides down your throat, with a firm and bouncy bite." — October 2026, autumn white tonkotsu soba and fried rice set ¥1,580.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺処 HACK、大阪市西区九条1-13-22 JJCourt九条 1F、九条駅から131m、月〜水・金〜日・祝 11:00〜22:30 (Instagramで通し営業に変更と告知)、木休み、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、2025年4月1日開店 (店舗情報は店公認ではない)。口コミ(2026年3〜10月): 2022年12月12日に浪速区難波で開店し2025年4月1日に九条へ移転、2026年3月に2号店 mendokoro HACK Nakazaki、一番人気の中華そばは昆布と貝の出汁、小麦の香り、2種のチャーシューと焼いた豚バラ、塩そば、3か月ごとに変わる白湯 (白豚骨) そば、秋は鮭と味噌の白湯そば1,180円 (泡立つ味噌の白豚骨、ゆるい縮れ麺、焼き鮭、チャーシュー、玉ねぎ・キャベツ・しめじの炒め野菜、もやし、木の芽、フライドオニオン、七味)、夏の四川成都担々白湯、春のホタルイカと桜えびの白湯と燻製の半熟卵、夏の冷やし担々麺 (レアチャーシュー、鶏むね、レモン、クリームチーズ、鶏そぼろ)、焦がし醤油の炒飯はバター増しや大盛り、セット1,580円、餃子、入口の券売機、現金のみ、厨房が見えるカウンター、丁寧な接客、店主から「NO NOODLE, NO LIFE」のステッカー、炒飯が少し塩辛いと感じる人もいるかもという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff guide first-timers to the ticket machine (June 2026); cash only.

osaka_sushi_amato_ura_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy-marinated tuna and soy on the nigiri; red miso soup; chawanmushi with ponzu.
osaka_sushi_amato_ura_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and shellfish throughout; shijimi soup; chawanmushi.
osaka_sushi_amato_ura_namba.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:00 (last order food 13:00, drinks 13:45) and 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). 10% service charge from 1 July 2026 (Tabelog). Lunch fills up; reserve ahead (October 2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_amato_ura_namba.notes: [Sushi · aged Edomae sushi with a ¥4,500 lunch, by Kuromon Market] The second shop of Sushi Amato, open since July 2025 up a flight of stairs two minutes from Nipponbashi, with fifteen seats at a hinoki counter. The style is aged Edomae: sea bream aged six days in kombu with sudachi salt, yellowtail aged five, marinated bluefin, on slightly firm rice seasoned with red vinegar. Lunch is the deal: a ten-piece omakase (¥4,500) with shijimi soup, chawanmushi, red miso soup and free tea. In the evening, fifteen-piece courses run ¥6,800–8,300; the top one, only served here, adds kinmedai, kinki, snow crab and sea urchin. A 10% service charge applies from July 2026. Lunch is popular, so reserve.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 7 July 2025 (Tabelog); the second shop of Sushi Amato (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Aging judged for each fish; sushi rice from a house blend of rice and red vinegar (October 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "What left a lasting impression was the kombu-cured sea bream, aged for six days. Served with sudachi salt, it enhanced the natural flavors of the ingredient…" — October 2026, Tensho omakase 10 pieces ¥4,500.
"The rice was cooked to a slightly firm texture, perfectly balancing with the toppings." — October 2026, Tensho omakase 15 pieces ¥6,800.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨 あまと 裏難波、大阪市中央区日本橋1-19-6 福喜ビル 2F、日本橋駅から徒歩2分、御堂筋線なんば駅から徒歩7分、毎日12:00〜14:00 (L.O. 料理13:00、ドリンク13:45)・16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、2026年7月1日からサービス料10%、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay を含む) 可、カウンター15席、2025年7月7日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ(2026年10月): 黒門市場のそば、Sushi Amato の2号店、ヒノキのカウンター、熟成の江戸前鮨、昼の Tensho おまかせ10貫4,500円 (しじみ汁、大トロ、6日熟成の昆布締めの鯛とすだち塩、熟成サーモン、アジ、ホタテ、漬けの本マグロ、ポン酢の茶碗蒸し、イカ、5日熟成のブリ、イクラ、ウナギ、赤だし、烏龍茶と緑茶飲み放題)、Tensho おまかせ15貫6,800円、ここだけの Ten Sho [Goku] おまかせ15貫8,300円 (大トロと中トロ、キンメダイ、キンキ、昆布の甘エビ、ズワイガニ、ウニ、トロたく巻き、デザート)、赤酢のシャリ、やや固めのご飯、日本酒 Mimuro Sugi、昼は人気で予約がおすすめ。

osaka_sushi_koshin_higashishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and seafood throughout; soft-shell turtle soup; seafood ramen; egg.
osaka_sushi_koshin_higashishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–22:00 in two seatings, 17:30–19:30 and 20:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Omakase ¥4,400 is the only option; all-you-can-drink +¥2,200 (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) only; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On 3F: take the emergency stairs from 2F; the door has no sign (October 2026).
osaka_sushi_koshin_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Sushi · ¥4,400 omakase that ends in seafood ramen, Higashi-Shinsaibashi] An eight-seat counter of the 881 Group, open since January 2026 on a hard-to-find third floor (take the emergency stairs from the second; the door has no sign). There's one course, ¥4,400, in two seatings at 17:30 and 20:00: soft-shell turtle soup, rare katsuo, then nigiri worked by aging, kombu-curing and vinegaring, such as four-day saba, kombu suzuki, sardine and nodoguro, plus a mackerel bozushi, steamed anago and a tuna and herring-roe hand roll. It finishes with a seafood shio ramen in the size you choose, then sweet tamago. All-you-can-drink is ¥2,200 more. Several diners rate the value outstanding. Lively, casual and good for a first sushi counter. Card only.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 5 January 2026 (Tabelog); part of the 881 Group (October 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Value sushi omakase ending in seafood ramen.

anecdotes.text: "Each piece of sushi was crafted with unique techniques like aging, kombu marination, vinegar curing, and marination… To finish, we had seafood ramen, with options for large, medium, or small sizes… The salt-based broth was rich with seafood flavor." — October 2026, omakase ¥4,400.
"The sushi here was of exceptionally high quality! You can really feel the attention to detail… The cost performance is outstanding." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨 滉心、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-5 東心斎橋ブルースタービル 3F、心斎橋駅から徒歩4分、毎日17:30〜22:00 (1部17:30〜19:30、2部20:00〜22:00)、カード (VISA、Master、JCB) 可、電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター8席、貸切可 (20名まで)、2026年1月5日開店。口コミ(2026年10月): 881 Group の店、おまかせ4,400円のみ、飲み放題+2,200円 (サッポロ赤星は2本まで)、すっぽんのスープと三つ葉、石垣島の塩と島らっきょうの漬物のカツオのたたき、4日熟成のサバ、昆布締めのスズキ、水ダコと吸盤、漬けマグロ、酢締めのイワシ、ノドグロ、サバの棒寿司、カマス、鯛の大根おろしソース、マグロと数の子の手巻き、蒸しアナゴ、かんぴょう巻き、玉子、トロたく巻き、締めは大中小を選べる魚介の塩ラーメン、2階から非常階段で3階、看板のない扉、コスパが良い、サプライズに対応、にぎやかで気軽。

cultural_comfort.note: Relaxed counter, recommended for a first sushi counter (October 2026); one set course.

osaka_sushi_zen_higashishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and seafood throughout; chawanmushi with mascarpone; milk pudding.

Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_zen_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Sushi · ¥18,000 aged-sushi course with drinks included, Higashi-Shinsaibashi] A calm ten-seat counter on a fourth floor, open since November 2025, with one all-in course (¥18,000) that includes alcohol or soft drinks. The rice is seasoned firmly with red vinegar and carries aged toppings, such as four-day sea bream, kombu-cured kisu and tuna from the Osaka supplier Teramoto Shoten, served as chutoro, marinated bluefin and otoro. Between pieces come creative plates: a mascarpone chawanmushi that eats like carbonara, Densuke anago shabu-shabu, abalone liver sauce and an uni don with two kinds of sea urchin. A fried mehikari roll and milk pudding close it out. Two seatings nightly, weekend lunch, reserve by the day before; 5% service charge.

chef_bio.philosophy: Aged toppings on red-vinegar rice; tuna from Teramoto Shoten (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged sushi course with drinks included.

anecdotes.text: "The sushi rice, made with a tangy red vinegar base, perfectly complements the well-aged toppings… the tuna here is sourced from Teramoto Shoten, a well-known supplier in Osaka." — July 2026.

"The chawanmushi with mascarpone cheese had a delightful Western twist… The highlight was the extravagant uni don topped with both purple and bafun uni!" — August 2026, ¥18,000 course with all-you-can-drink.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨し禅、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-15 アルスビル 4F、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日18:00〜と20:30〜の二部制 (〜23:00)、土日祝は12:00から昼営業、定休日不定、予約は前日まで、サービス料5%、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay を含む) 可、カウンター10席、2025年11月18日開店。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年10月): 酒かソフトドリンクが込みのコース18,000円、4日熟成の鯛とカツオの刺身、自家製ごま豆腐、マスカルポーネのカルボナーラ風茶碗蒸し、湯葉と生クリーム、Densuke アナゴのしゃぶしゃぶ、アブラボウズの西京焼き、アワビの肝ソース、中トロ、漬けの本マグロ、大トロ、昆布締めのキス、甘エビ、紫ウニとバフンウニのウニ丼、トロたく、メヒカリの揚げ巻き、ウナギ、ミルクプリン、赤酢のシャリ、大阪の Teramoto Shoten のマグロ、落ち着いたカウンター、料理の間合いと気配り。

cultural_comfort.note: Calm counter; attentive staff (October 2026); reserve by the day before.

osaka_jidori_nabe_miura_higashishinsaiba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta; baguette; chicken ponzu.
osaka_jidori_nabe_miura_higashishinsaiba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broth hot pot; chicken sashimi; chicken prosciutto; cheese.
osaka_jidori_nabe_miura_higashishinsaiba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and public holidays 17:30–23:00; closed Sun, and on Mondays that are public holidays (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Run by three staff (December 2025).
osaka_jidori_nabe_miura_higashishinsaiba.notes: [Chicken · mizutaki hot pot of jidori chicken in Higashi-Shinsaibashi] A calm, Japanese-style mizutaki specialist on the fifth floor of a bar building just off the arcade from Shinsaibashi, with a short counter, low kotatsu tables and three staff. The courses start with chicken plates (peperoncino, a tsukune hamburger, chicken prosciutto, and sashimi on the Sai course) before the hot pot, which staff cook for you. Gunma black chicken is tender in a rich but not heavy broth, with soft cabbage, grated yam and house yuzu-kosho. Finish with broth poured over rice, zosui or tea rice. One diner liked the pasta with lettuce enough to want seconds. Courses run from the small Hashi upward. Seen off at the elevator. Cards accepted; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.specialty: Mizutaki of jidori chicken; chicken courses.

anecdotes.text: "The main dish, Mizutaki, features a broth that balances richness without being overpowering… The chicken comes from Gunma, specifically the black chicken. Despite being free-range, the meat is wonderfully tender." — January 2025.
"Despite the hot summer, I opted for the chicken hot pot, and the chicken broth was simply outstanding. I finished off with a tea rice dish…" — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: じどりなべ三浦、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-27 日宝ニューコロンブスビル 5F、心斎橋駅から徒歩2〜3分、月〜土・祝 17:30〜23:00、日休み、祝日の月曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、20席 (カウンター4、テーブル3、うち2卓は小上がりの掘りごたつ)。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年10月): 水炊き専門、群馬の黒い地鶏、やわらかい、濃厚だが重すぎないスープ、柔らかく煮た白菜、とろろ、自家製の柚子胡椒、ご飯にスープをかける締め、雑炊、茶漬け、ペペロンチーノ、つくねハンバーグ、鶏の生ハム、Sai コースの鶏刺し、鶏しゃぶ、鍋は店の人が作る、一番小さい Hashi コースと鶏ポン酢、レタス入りのパスタ、バゲットと鶏の生ハムとチーズ、首肉の塩焼き、デザート、スタッフ3人、エレベーターまで見送り、和の落ち着いた雰囲気、バーや飲食店の入るビル、料理を出す間合い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff cook the hot pot; warm send-off (2025–2026); cards accepted.
